task: ChatGPT KCP v1.0 (2026-11-26) 中央版 KCP-JRA, CAL-05; Owner approval 2026-11-26 (「登録してよい（推奨）」)
no_use: SSR-W and the calibrated values are not probabilities for EV, Kelly, Role, MEC, Capital or Delivery
input: signed FINAL krs_prediction_utility.summary SSR-W (KRS-Engine v1.1.0, parameter_map 0.1-provisional); winner from the stored official result

arms.KCP-C2: p proportional to SSR-W ** (1/2.65), renormalised per race

fit: T chosen by grid 0.30..3.00 step 0.05 minimising win log loss on race days 2026-10-11..2026-11-07 (209 races); fixed, never refitted inside the evaluation
primary: paired win log loss per race (C2 - B1), lower is better
engine_change_rule: if the engine or parameter_map version changes, the race is excluded and the arm is re-registered
promotion_eligible: >= 100 forward races with 95% CI upper < 0 on the primary; Owner decision only. Promotion would only allow the calibrated value to be shown as a frequency, not EV/Kelly
